yogas.name: Budhaditya Yoga
yogas.description: Sun and Mercury conjoined. Gives sharp intellect and communication skills.

yogas.name: Kemadruma Yoga
yogas.description: No planets in 2nd or 12th from Moon. May indicate financial struggles or loneliness.

yogas.name: Adhi Yoga
yogas.description: Natural benefics (Jupiter) occupy the 6th, 7th, or 8th houses from the Moon. Grants high status, fame, prosperity, leadership, and a highly influential life.

yogas.name: Kahala Yoga
yogas.description: 4th Lord (Venus) and 9th Lord (Venus) occupy mutual Kendra positions. Confers tenacious determination, command over organizations or teams, and fearless fortitude.

yogas.name: Neechabhanga Raja Yoga (Sun)
yogas.description: Debilitation of Sun in Libra is cancelled because the lord of its exaltation sign (Mars) is in Kendra (House 4) from Lagna. This forms a Raja Yoga conferring ultimate authority, leadership, and great success after overcoming initial struggles.

sade_sati.description: Saturn is not currently transiting the 12th, 1st, or 2nd houses from your Moon. You are not currently going through Sade Sati.
